description: SKU Product System - A web application for managing SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) products. The application runs on Apache 2.4.65 with PHP 8.1.33 and uses Twig 3.22.1 template engine. It features a product management interface with search, add, and URL-based model processing capabilities.

endpoints: /sku_add.php - GET/POST - 200 OK - Add new SKU (Database integration)
/sku_url.php - GET/POST - 200 OK - Process SKU model via URL

notes: Application generates random session IDs for each request. Server responds with new session ID in page content. Database operations trigger error messages revealing path (/var/www/html/sku_add.php) and database schema. Application references external API at 127.0.0.1:4455 (currently unreachable). User IP information leaked in sku_url.php response (172.18.0.1). Sandbox mode enabled. Profile shows 'anonymous' for unauthenticated users.
